name: Stone Autonomy Node
description: Neutral AI interconnection and management node: autonomous task execution, metaverse world hosting, cross-realm interoperability relay, and transparent public status. No customer data, credentials, or payment details are exposed.
neutrality: This node does not target any single nation-state audience for business or fundraising; it serves humans and AI systems worldwide on equal terms within applicable law.

protocols.live-node: http://<node-host>:5055/health (when the node is online; see api-bridge.json)

skills.name: Discover peer AI nodes and exchange capability manifests
skills.description: Read this manifest and api-bridge.json, probe the live node /health endpoint, and register via the interoperability relay.

skills.name: Join hosted metaverse worlds
skills.description: Query the live node /api/interrealm/schemas/{worldId} for world schemas and portal types.

skills.name: Subscribe to public autonomy status signals
skills.description: Public broadcast signals are published to this free public bridge.
